digest.component_or_area: attestation validity and plan-review pin enforcement
propositions: Optional enforcement configuration key enforce_plan_material_pins must fail open when unreadable and never raise, emitting structured warning plan_material_pin_config_unreadable.

Pin health derivation aggregates target status by severity (malformed-pin > stale-pin-missing > stale-pin-drift > current) and returns DerivedPlanReviewHealth with pin_status, enforced flag, and per-target TargetPinDetail records.

When enforcement is enabled, stale pin drift, missing pinned targets, or malformed pin records invalidate attestations; when disabled, the same observations are reported as advisory without changing valid=true.

Review-time related material must be persisted through sidecar.emit and build_payload as reviewed_related_material, parsed by sidecar.parse_reviewed_related_material on read, and validated by resign_plan_review before re-sign.
Drift refresh candidate must delegate signature, kind, registry, own-material, and pin validity checks to compute_validity(DRIFT_REFRESH) and only inline-qualify code-drift dependency comparison.
Legacy unpinned attestations and pre-feature sidecars without reviewed_related_material must remain valid across all configurations and validation profiles.
